newsitem.title: USA: Protective life to buy West Coast Life.
newsitem.headline: Protective life to buy West Coast Life.

text.p: Protective Life Corp said Tuesday it had agreed to buy West Coast Life Insurance Co from Nationwide Insurance Enterprise for about $257 million.
The transaction is subject to regulatory approval and certain customary closing conditions.
West Coast Life, based in San Francisco, sells universal life and traditional life products and has about $750 million of assets and over $100 million of annual premiums.

Protective Life, based in Birmingham, Ala., provides financial services through the production, distribution and administration of insurance and investment products through subsidiaries in the United States and Hong Kong. It has revenues of about $1 billion and assets of $8.3 billion.
West Coast Life is not owned or controlled by Nationwide Insurance's Nationwide Financial Services Inc business, which recently completed an initial public offering.
